- [Laravel Queues on Steroids](https://x.com/LaravelAhm/status/1867277929610457578): LaravelLive Ahmedabad, Dec 22, 2024. Performance and optimization techniques for Laravel Queues, including queue management strategies for large-scale background processing.
- [Speeding Up Your Large-Scale Laravel App, Part 2](https://x.com/LaravelAhm/status/1760912096370307409): LaravelLive Ahmedabad, Feb 25, 2024. Second part of the series: database optimization, caching strategies, and application profiling for large-scale applications.
- [Speeding Up Your Large-Scale Laravel App](https://x.com/LaravelAhm/status/1684448175833378816): LaravelLive Ahmedabad, Jul 30, 2023. Foundations of scaling Laravel: query optimization, eager loading, caching, and performance monitoring for high-traffic applications.
- [Working with Laravel Observers](https://x.com/LaravelAhm/status/1603798887432876033): LaravelLive Ahmedabad, Dec 18, 2022. Practical use of Laravel Observers: handling model events cleanly while keeping the codebase maintainable.
